title: Plugin Development Approval Configuration
description: Configure which approval points Bob should ask for user confirmation. Set 'enabled: true' to ask, 'enabled: false' to proceed automatically.

mcp_tool_failure_fallback.description: Ask user to choose fallback method when MCP tool (search_ansible_galaxy_collections) fails

collection_already_exists.description: Ask user whether to use existing collection or download latest when collection already exists in venv

authentication_method_selection.description: Ask user to select authentication method after analyzing available options from integration source

test_data_option.description: Ask user to choose between providing test credentials or mock data files

playbook_retry_after_failure.description: Ask user whether to retry after playbook failure (if false, auto-retry up to 3 times for playbook issues, stop immediately for credential issues)

transformation_validation_retry.description: Ask user whether to retry after transformation validation failure (if false, auto-retry with fixes)

ui_schema_field_confirmation.description: Ask user to confirm each field before adding to UI schema (if false, auto-generate based on playbook analysis)

deployment_confirmation.description: Ask user to confirm deployment to GCM after packaging

proceed_to_next_phase.description: Ask user to confirm before proceeding to next phase (if false, auto-proceed after successful completion)

checkpoint_update_notification.description: Notify user after updating CHECKPOINT.md (if false, update silently)
